name: Epidemiology Methods for Road Traffic Injuries
description: Introduction to traffic injury data and epidemiology; case-control and case-crossover; poisson and negative binomial count models; empirical bayes and controlled before-after; evaluation of natural experiments; quasi-experimental methods; interrupted time series; capture-recapture; population-based survey methods; systematic reviews and meta-analysis.
